notes: DONE: 3535 unique URLs, 31/31 days 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 (09-30=148, 10-10=70, 10-20=135, min 62), 36 API requests, ~20s wall. Route: robots.txt (200, permissive; disallows only /wp-admin/ and /*?s=) names two sitemaps: /sitemaps/index.xml (numbered post sitemaps, Yoast-style, lastmod=edit time - avoided) and /sitemaps/news.xml (200, has news:publication_date but only the newest ~500 URLs, covering 2026-10-21..26 only - too little for the window). Final route: WordPress REST API https://www.g4media.ro/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?_fields=date,link,date_gmt&per_page=100&page=N, paginated newest-first (36 pages) until date_gmt < window start. Listed date = date_gmt (UTC), which is EXACTLY what article pages state as JSON-LD datePublished (+00:00) and matches the news sitemap's publication_date; site-local 'date' would also work (within 1 day) but date_gmt matches the page exactly. Filtered out 2 economedia.ro sister-site cross-posts that appear in the g4media feed. Verified 8 sample articles across 09-25/09-30/10-10/10-20/10-25: all 200, 9.3k-12k chars of text, page datePublished == listed date on every one.
